# NepaCalc - AI Navigation Guide

NepaCalc is a free, comprehensive suite of online calculators, converters, and live market rate tools built for Nepal and general use worldwide.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://nepacalc.com/)
- [Calculator Directory](https://nepacalc.com/calculator/)
- [Search](https://nepacalc.com/search/)
